item.title: Public feedback wanted for power line's environmental report
item.description: Public feedback is sought for the draft environmental report of Hydro One’s Northeast Power Line. The proposed project would see a single-circuit,500 kilovolt transmission line built between transformer stations in Hanmer and near Wharncliffe, a release says. More information is available at HydroOne.com/NortheastPowerLine. Public comments are accepted until March 19 at 4:30 p.m. Email CommunityRelations@HydroOne.com […]

item.title: Blast furnaces still needed for steel: COLUMN
item.description: HIistory is written in metal. The Stone Age ended not because we ran out of stone but because we learned to smelt copper and tin. The Bronze Age gave us cities, writing and empires. item.title: Thessalon’s Shilo Rousseau set for Olympic biathlon debut
item.description: The 25-year-old Thessalon biathlete will carry a family legacy and proudly represent Canada as an openly LGBTQ athlete beginning Feb. 8.
